summary: Backend: 29/30 pytest tests passing (96.6%). Found and FIXED a critical bug: tz-naive vs tz-aware datetime comparison crashed GET /api/invitations/by-token/{token} (500) and effective_permissions when expires_at was set. Remaining failure is Nominatim 429 rate-limiting under parallel test load (third-party, low priority, noted in review request). Frontend: full onboarding walk-through works up to add-member sheet; login as ana.demo lands on /map with sentinel-orb, group-mini-orb-1, privacy-shortcut and 7 orb-family chips visible. Add-member sheet has a viewport/scroll issue: membership/duration/channel rows and submit fall outside the 390x844 viewport and require scrolling inside the sheet. Location permission bottom-sheet overlay blocks orb-tool interactions on the map right after login. Deprecated RN web style props detected: shadow* and props.pointerEvents.

critical.issue: TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes. Mongo returned expires_at as naive; now() is aware. FIXED locally by normalising to UTC before comparison in /app/backend/routers/groups.py:216 and /app/backend/routers/consent.py:160.

minor.issue: When geocode provider returns non-200 (e.g. Nominatim 429), the meeting is created with destination=null and status 201. This silently degrades the feature. Preferable: return 503 SERVICE_NOT_CONFIGURED consistent with truthful-state rule, or explicit 'provider_error' state client-side.

Nominatim public endpoint frequently returns 429 under parallel/burst load; backend correctly translates this to 503 Unavailable(service). Truthful, but flaky. Consider a small server-side throttle or 1s spacing helper.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390x844, membership-temporary, duration-72, channel-sms and add-member-submit are below the viewport fold inside the bottom sheet; Playwright click('membership-temporary', force=True) failed 'Element is outside of the viewport'. Sheet content needs an internal ScrollView or reduced padding.
Selector avatar-color-0 / avatar-symbol-shield did not resolve within 30s. testIDs on color/symbol buttons appear to use a different naming convention than the review spec.

Right after login on /map, a bottom sheet 'Permiso de ubicación del dispositivo' overlays the lower half of the screen. It intercepts taps on orb-tool-sheet actions (orb-tool-plan click timed out until sheet was dismissed).

integration_issues.issue: Screen defaults to 'Crear cuenta' with no test hook to switch to login mode. Add testID 'account-mode-login' to the 'Ya tengo cuenta' button so automated flows can toggle deterministically.

issues: Bottom sheet exceeds mobile safe area; needs internal scroll or reduced padding at <= 390x844

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Reference: console warning printed on onboarding screens.
'props.pointerEvents' is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents. Reference: console warning printed on onboarding screens.

action_items: Verify the backend datetime-fix patches I applied in routers/groups.py and routers/consent.py; consider centralising an 'ensure_utc(dt)' helper in core.py
Make POST /api/meetings return an explicit provider_error state (or 503) when geocoding fails so the UI can show 'SERVICIO NO CONFIGURADO' truthfully instead of receiving destination=null
Add internal ScrollView to add-member-sheet so membership/duration/channel/submit stay reachable at 390x844
Rename avatar picker testIDs to match spec: avatar-color-<index> (0..n) and avatar-symbol-<pin|shield|car|star|heart>
Make sure the map location-permission bottom sheet does not overlap sentinel-orb / orb-tool-sheet interactions, or dismiss it automatically once user has already granted consent server-side
Add testID 'account-mode-login' to the 'Ya tengo cuenta' toggle on onboarding/account.tsx

critical_code_review_comments: core.py exposes datetime tz-awareness (now() is UTC-aware) but stored/re-read Mongo datetimes are naive when not carrying tz — every '<' comparison in Python must normalise. Two occurrences found; audit the remaining call sites (positions TTL is server-side, safe).
routers/coordination.py:create_meeting swallows geocode failures and returns 201 with destination=None — inconsistent with the app's absolute rule of truthful unavailable states.
server.py:47 registers CORS middleware AFTER app.include_router; middleware still applies for FastAPI but conventional order is before include_router — not a functional bug, cosmetic.

success_rate.frontend: ~70% (core flows verified; add-member sheet and orb-tool interactions blocked by UI issues)

seed_data_creation: Registration creates TEST_-prefixed users (@sentinelfamily.app). No fixed seed data was inserted beyond what pytest creates per session; all inserted docs are marked TEST_ for cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Nominatim (public) is rate-limited (~1 req/s, returns 429 under bursts). Prefer sequential geocode calls in tests, or add sleep(1.5) between them. Existing owner ana.demo@sentinelfamily.app / Sentinel2026! is already past onboarding — use 'Ya tengo cuenta' toggle to switch account screen to login mode. Map bottom-sheet 'Permiso de ubicación del dispositivo' must be dismissed (or accept 'Ahora no') before interacting with sentinel-orb tools.
rca_of_issue: GET /api/invitations/by-token/{token} 500 error: PyMongo/Motor decodes BSON datetimes as offset-naive; core.now() returns offset-aware (datetime.now(timezone.utc)). Direct '<' comparison of the two raises TypeError. RCA: no normalisation layer between Mongo reads and business logic. Reproduction: 1) create temporary invitation with duration_hours=72, 2) GET /api/invitations/by-token/<token>. Mitigation applied: convert naive datetimes to UTC-aware via replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) prior to comparison. Long-term: add an 'ensure_utc(dt)' helper in core.py and use it consistently, or configure motor client with tz_aware=True (AsyncIOMotorClient(..., tz_aware=True)).
